revisions.provenance: all four reports were produced from clean worktrees; control A1/A2 and candidate B1/B2 revisions match their leg identities

commands.protocol: A1 control, B1 candidate, B2 candidate, A2 control; one fresh CPU-pinned release process per ABBA leg; selected CFB cases execute in-process, not in a fresh child per sample
commands.selector_matrix: 12 named cfb_open_stream_mini selectors × many-small and wide-root corpus shapes

selected_case_execution.processes: one fresh CPU-pinned release process per ABBA leg
selected_case_execution.note: filesystem cache-state, fresh-child, process-isolation, filesystem-root, and range-simulation values are retained generic report configuration and are not exercised by the selected CFB cases

source_event_notation.scope: per-operation logical positional source events; parser-open physical reads are summarized separately by open_read_calls/open_read_bytes
source_event_notation.E: empty per-operation source-event list (zero calls and zero bytes)

observed_review_triggers.decision: timing claim withheld because final ABBA review triggers exceed the 5% policy; no timing claim is made

accepted: Across all 48,000 retained samples, the selected CFB target payloads preserve output hashes, exact returned lengths, source-version checks, and typed-refusal invariants.

The candidate concurrent same-target logical source vectors are D or D,D, while control permits D,D or C,D/D,C; non-concurrent one-shot, repeat, different-SID, and bulk formulas remain D, D...; D,C,E; and C respectively.

Across four concurrent records per leg and 500 samples per record, pooled across the A1/A2 control and B1/B2 candidate legs, logical source calls are 8,000 control versus 6,473 candidate: 1,527 fewer calls, a 19.09% reduction.
withheld: No local elapsed, open, operation, or source-total latency improvement claim: paired ABBA timing contains greater-than-5-percent regressions and same-implementation drift in the retained matrix.
No generic wall-clock, allocation, RSS, peak-memory, physical-I/O, cold-cache, remote/network/device, decompression, native DOC/XLS/PPT, OOXML, ODF, RTF, or iWork performance claim.
tradeoffs: Concurrent event vectors are scheduler-dependent and are recorded as permitted multisets rather than one deterministic order.
The 19.09% logical-call reduction is source-event evidence only; it does not establish a local latency improvement.
